title: Settings
external_hint: any OpenAI-compatible endpoint — cloud provider or a local server (Ollama, vLLM, LM Studio)
no_key_warn: No API key configured — paste a key below and save. Generation works without one only for providers that skip authentication.
sidecar_online: sidecar online · {{n}}/{{total}} llm models downloaded — manage downloads under “Local models”
sidecar_offline: sidecar offline — start it with make mesh-server, then download an llm model under “Local models”
vision_needed: pipeline needs a vision-capable local model — intake/critique read images
key_isset_hint: a key is stored — enter a new one to replace it (never shown again)
key_hint: stored encrypted in the app database, write-only
key_removed: the stored API key will be removed on save
hf_hint: hf_… token — forwarded to the sidecar for gated repos and higher rate limits; empty = anonymous; stored encrypted
img_key_hint: empty = reuse the LLM API key
fem_disclaimer: engineering feedback only — not a certification tool
tripo_hint: image → 3D via the hosted Tripo3D API — no local weights needed
mesh_offline_post: Mesh/hybrid modes fall back to CAD while it is unreachable.
openai_img_hint: text-to-image and image editing via the OpenAI images API — empty connection fields reuse the LLM provider config
sidecar_img_hint: text-to-image and image editing on the same mesh-server sidecar — for concept images, design ideation, img2img variations and auto-generated hero images for mesh mode.
img_offline_pre: mesh-server sidecar unreachable — image generation shares it; start it with
img_none_post: for setup (FLUX.1-schnell on MLX/CUDA, SDXL fallback).
exec_caps_hint: hard outer caps are set by docker (cpus/mem_limit, auto-sized at startup); these apply inside the sandbox
runtime_hint: all runtime settings are stored in the app database — infrastructure (database, redis, ports) is fixed by docker compose / launcher defaults
saved_unsaved: unsaved changes — apply to new jobs; running jobs keep their snapshot

f.llm_tools_h: auto: fall back per model when the provider rejects tools; on: strict; off: legacy JSON steps
f.llm_context_tokens_h: 0 = auto-detect from the provider (probed lazily, cached); >0 = manual override
f.llm_max_tokens_h: 0 = auto — derived from the detected context window and clamped so prompt + completion fits
f.llm_extra_body_h: merged into every request, e.g. {"chat_template_kwargs": {"enable_thinking": false}}
f.llm_model_vision_h: used for image analysis & visual critique
f.llm_sidecar_model_h: serve one model for all roles instead of separate vision/code picks
f.agent_context_budget_frac_h: share of the detected context window a prompt may fill before history is condensed early
f.agent_patch_mode_h: auto: patch on repair, rewrite on improve
f.agent_mesh_tools_h: MESH_REFINE session: agent fixes generated meshes with transform ops instead of blind re-generation
f.agent_mesh_hard_fail_score_h: a generation scoring ≤ this with major issues counts as a hard fail
f.agent_mesh_hard_fail_limit_h: after this many consecutive hard fails the mesh loop stops (CAD fallback for dimensioned parts)
f.chat_model_role_h: vision: the agent can see uploaded + generated images; code: text-only (image tools limited to captions)
f.chat_spawn_timeout_s_h: how long a chat turn blocks on a spawned job before returning control
f.mesh_base_url_h: e.g. http://localhost:8765 (native) or http://mesh-server:8765 (compose gpu profile); empty = disabled
f.mesh_model_h: auto picks by device. On Apple-silicon MPS the hunyuan3d-2mv variant can stall under memory pressure — prefer hunyuan3d-2.1-mlx or the mini/turbo variants there.
f.mesh_min_free_mb_h: refuse new generation jobs when the sidecar host has less free RAM — 0 disables. Prevents MPS stalls under memory pressure.
f.image_edit_model_h: used when a reference image is given (img2img / instruction edit)
f.image_autogen_mesh: Auto hero image for mesh runs
f.image_autogen_mesh_h: synthesise a reference image when a mesh/hybrid job has no input images
f.fem_verify_mesh_shift_h: re-voxelize shifted ½ pitch — grid sensitivity
f.fem_homog_cell_voxels_h: voxel size of one representative cell
f.exec_threads_h: 0 = auto — OCC meshing, BLAS, software raster
f.exec_pool_workers_h: 0 = auto; 1 disables FEM case pool / pipeline fan-out

mdl_none: no {{kind}} models known to the sidecar
upd_offline_pre: the updater daemon isn't reachable — start the stack via
upd_dirty_warn: {{n}} uncommitted change(s) — the update refuses a dirty tree: commit or stash first.
upd_restarting: stack is restarting — waiting for it to come back…
upd_uptodate_hint: already up to date on this channel
upd_body_b: , reinstalls dependencies, rebuilds images and restarts the whole stack — expect a few minutes of downtime.
upd_jobs_warn: {{n}} generation job(s) are still running — they will be interrupted.
upd_dirty_body: working tree has uncommitted changes — the update will refuse.
upd_rb_warn: database migrations are forward-only — if the failed update included one, rolling code back can break the app (back up data/ first).
